title: Elf Bar 600 Strawberry Snoow Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Elf Bar 600 Strawberry Snoow Prefilled Pods are made for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, offering a playful twist on a sweet classic. Each pod holds 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and delivers up to 600 puffs with a smooth MTL draw. Flavour-wise, juicy Strawberry is lifted with Ice-Cream inspired sweetness for a light, fun vape. Once empty, simply replace the pod for a quick and mess-free experience.
